I specialize in building high-performance desktop applications using MFC (C++), while maintaining a flexible mindset for modern web development with NodeJS, PHP, and the HTML/CSS/JS triad. The synergy between system-level programming and web technology agility allows me to approach complex problems comprehensively. I am always seeking opportunities to optimize software performance and deliver the best possible user experience.
